name: Number Format
description: The number format of a cell or range — '#,##0.00' for money, '0%' for a rate, 'dd/mm/yyyy' for a date, '0' for a count — so Excel shows the value the way the reader expects.

data.assignments: [{"variable":"result","value":"{{= (() => { const ws = workbook.getWorksheet(sheet); if (!ws) throw new Error('No sheet named ' + sheet); const [a, b] = String(range).split(':'); const from = ws.getCell(a), to = ws.getCell(b || a); for (let r = from.row; r <= to.row; r++) for (let c = from.col; c <= to.col; c++) ws.getCell(r, c).numFmt = String(format); return workbook; })() }}"}]
